climate: Best period: January-March, temperatures 25-32°C, calm sea. Avoid April-May (scorching heat 38-42°C, oppressive humidity) and October-December (northeast monsoon, heavy rains along the entire coast, cyclone risk). July-September: lighter monsoon but rain possible.

title: Gujarat: Grand UNESCO Sites Tour in 15 Days
subtitle: This circuit links the historic city of Ahmedabad to the white desert of Kutch in 15 days, through Gujarat's greatest treasures.
climate: Best time: November to February, mild temperatures 15-28°C, clear skies. Avoid April-June (scorching heat 40-45°C, Kutch roads challenging) and July-September (monsoon season). The Rann of Kutch desert is spectacular in winter but unbearable the rest of the year.

title: From Coast to Jungle: Bhubaneswar to Bhopal in 16 Days
subtitle: A 16-day road trip through solar temples, tiger reserves, and prehistoric caves.
climate: Best time: November to February, 20-30°C, clear skies. Absolutely avoid April-June (extreme heat 38-45°C) and July-September (heavy monsoon on the coast, difficult roads). Cyclone risk in October-November along Odisha.

title: Wild Iceland: Snæfellsnes & Westfjords in 8 Days
subtitle: Iceland off the beaten path, from Snæfellsnes volcanoes to Europe's most remote fjords
climate: Best period: June to August, temperatures 10-15°C, nearly continuous daylight. Avoid September-May: Westfjords roads often closed, severe storms, partial polar night in winter. Always pack warm, waterproof layers—conditions change within hours.

title: Iceland Road Trip: The Ring Road in 12 Days
subtitle: Complete circuit around the island via the Ring Road, from Reykjavik to the eastern fjords through the southern glaciers and northern volcanoes
climate: Best period: June to August, temperatures 10-15°C, endless daylight and Ring Road fully accessible. Avoid November to March (near-permanent darkness, severe storms, road closures). Wind and rain possible year-round, weather changes within hours.

title: Complete Iceland: Highlands, Glaciers & Fjords in 18 Days
subtitle: The ultimate Icelandic adventure combining the Ring Road with remote Highlands - Landmannalaugar, Kerlingarfjöll, Vatnajökull glaciers and eastern fjords
climate: Mandatory period: mid-June to early September (10-15°C), the only window when Highland F-roads are open. Rest of the year, the central highlands and Landmannalaugar are completely inaccessible. Pack warm and waterproof layers even in summer: wind, rain, and abrupt weather changes occur anytime.

title: Calabria: From Cosenza to Reggio, Between Mountains and Ionian Sea
subtitle: A 6 days road trip through wild Calabria, from the perched villages of Pollino to the white cliffs of Tropea and the ancient bronzes of Reggio.
climate: Best time: April-May and September-October, temperatures 20-26°C, pleasant sea. Avoid July-August: frequent heatwaves (35-40°C), especially inland; Sila mountains stay cooler. Mild coastal winter (12-15°C) but rainy.

title: Complete Calabria Loop: Tyrrhenian and Ionian Coasts
subtitle: From Pizzo and Tropea on the Tyrrhenian coast to the Riace Bronzes in Reggio, then up the Ionian shore via Gerace, Crotone, and the ruins of Magna Graecia
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 22-28°C, pleasant sea. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 32-38°C, crowded beaches) and November-February (frequent rain, wind). Coastal areas stay mild in winter but swimming is off-limits.

title: From Naples to the Lucanian Dolomites: Secret Campania and the Amalfi Coast
subtitle: An 9 days journey through Naples' alleyways, Procida's pastel houses, Caserta's Italian Versailles, Irpinia's forgotten villages, Castelmezzano's dizzying cliffs, and the panoramic Amalfi Coast.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-28°C on the coast, cooler in the Lucanian Dolomites. Avoid July-August (sweltering heat up to 35°C, massive crowds on the Amalfi Coast). Rainy autumn-winter in Naples, mountain roads challenging in winter.

title: Dolomites Loop: Alpine Lakes, Mountain Pastures & Limestone Peaks
subtitle: From Merano and its thermal gardens to Lago di Braies and the Tre Cime di Lavaredo, the grand Dolomites loop through Val Gardena, Cortina d'Ampezzo and Alta Pusteria
climate: Best period: June to September, daytime temperatures 15-25°C, cool evenings. Avoid November-April (heavy snow, mountain passes closed). Afternoon thunderstorms common in summer at higher elevations.

title: Castles of the Piacenza Hills: A 2-Day Medieval Road Trip Through Northern Italy
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-27°C. Avoid July-August (scorching heat up to 35°C, high humidity). Cold winter with frequent fog in the Po Valley.

title: Udine & Friuli Circuit: Hidden Treasures
subtitle: From Palmanova's star fortress to Venzone's mummies, a journey through Venetian squares, world-class mosaics, emerald torrents, and prosciutto traditions
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C, ideal for exploring Palmanova and alpine villages. Avoid July-August (heavy heat up to 32°C in lowlands) and December-February (cold, persistent fog, frequent frost near Venzone). Spring thunderstorms possible in mountain areas.

title: Lombardy's Most Beautiful Villages in 5 Days
subtitle: From the mill town of Crespi d'Adda to lakeside fortresses, a journey through ten centuries of Lombard history
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temps 15-25°C on the lakes, ideal for driving. Avoid July-August (oppressive heat in the plains, heavy crowds) and winter (fog in lowlands, alpine passes to Bormio closed by snow until May).

title: Piedmont's Most Beautiful Villages in 2 Weeks
subtitle: From the Occitan Alps to the northern lakes - 14 days exploring Piedmont's certified villages, through UNESCO vineyards, medieval architecture, and pristine alpine valleys.
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, mountain passes open. Avoid December-March (alpine roads closed by snow, mountain villages inaccessible). July-August hot in Langhe region (28-32°C), but cooler at altitude.

title: Rieti, Holy Valley & Sabine Lakes Circuit
subtitle: From the Franciscan sanctuaries of the Reatine plain to the turquoise waters of Lake Turano, through perched medieval villages, ancient abbeys, and Apennine peaks
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C in the valley. Avoid July-August (intense heat up to 35°C) and winter for hiking (Terminillo is snow-covered December-March). Mountain road closed during snowfall.

title: Ulysses Riviera: Secret Gardens, Ancient Caves & Southern Lazio Islands
subtitle: From Ninfa's medieval Pompeii to Ponza's Roman caves
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-25°C, ideal for caves and gardens. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 30-35°C, crowded beaches). Mild winter but rainy; rough seas to Ponza.

title: Italy Road Trip from Nice: Riviera & Alps in 2 Days
subtitle: From the medieval valley of Dolceacqua to the Alpine heights of Limone Piemonte, following the Riviera dei Fiori through Sanremo, Imperia, and Cuneo.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C on the coast, 10-20°C in the mountains. Avoid July-August (heat on the Riviera, crowds) and December-March (snowy Alpine passes, road closures). Significant temperature difference between coast and Alps.

title: Grand Tour of the Italian Lakes: Milan, Lakes Maggiore, Como and Verona
subtitle: From Milan to Verona, an enchanting journey through the most beautiful lakes and art cities of northern Italy
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C, ideal for lake touring. Avoid July-August (heavy heat up to 32°C, peak tourist crowds) and November-March (cold dampness, persistent fog over Milan and the plain). Frequent afternoon thunderstorms in summer.

title: The Hidden Villages of Le Marche
subtitle: 29 medieval hilltowns of Le Marche, from the Adriatic coast to the foothills of the Apennines
keywords: hidden Italy off the beaten track
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, with comfortable 18-26°C ideal for hilltop village touring. Avoid July-August (intense heat up to 35°C inland, tourist crowds). Harsh winter in mountain villages like Visso: challenging roads, temperatures near freezing.

title: Italian Lakes & Dolomites Road Trip: Piedmont to Venice
subtitle: Alpine lakes, medieval towns, and soaring Dolomite peaks in 15 days
climate: Best time: May-June and September-early October, temperatures 20-26°C, ideal for lakes and mountain hiking. Avoid July-August (scorching heat on lakes 30-35°C, massive crowds) and November-March (persistent fog on lakes, Dolomite roads closed by snow). Afternoon thunderstorms common in summer.

title: Italy Road Trip: From Trentino to the Amalfi Coast
subtitle: Twenty days through Italy's greatest treasures—from Alpine valleys to medieval towers, Renaissance Florence to ancient Rome, and finally the dramatic cliffs and azure waters of the Tyrrhenian coast.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C from north to south. Avoid July-August (oppressive heat 30-38°C, massive crowds in Rome and on the Amalfi Coast). Trento can be cool in spring, Naples and Amalfi stay mild in winter.

title: Emilia-Romagna's Hidden Treasures: Castles, Apennines & the Great Labyrinth
climate: Best period: May-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C, ideal for castles and mountain trails. Avoid July-August (oppressive heat 30-35°C, heavy humidity in the plains) and December-February (cold, thick fog in the Po Valley, snow in mountains). Watch for frequent fog in autumn-winter at lower elevations.

title: Grand Alpine Valleys of Piedmont: Occitan Alps, Lakes & Baroque Savoy
subtitle: From the high Occitan Stura to the pre-alpine lakes of Orta, this 6 days circuit climbs through Piedmont from southwest to northeast: the Marquisate of Saluzzo, baroque Turin, Walser valleys of Monte Rosa, and UNESCO Sacred Mountains.
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C in the valleys. Avoid July-August (scorching heat in the plains, severe thunderstorms in the mountains) and winter (closed mountain passes, persistent fog). Some alpine passes remain impassable until late May.

title: Hidden Beaches in Italy: Secluded Coves and Turquoise Waters
climate: Best time: May-June and September-mid-October, temperatures 22-28°C, pleasant sea, uncrowded beaches. Avoid July-August (scorching heat in the south, crowds even at hidden coves, prices doubled). Mild winter but many services closed, cool sea (14-16°C).

title: Secret Puglia: Frederick II's Castles, Hidden Hinterland & Forgotten Villages
subtitle: From north to south: Bari to Brindisi through Puglia's untouched interior in 7 days.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for exploring the inland areas. Avoid July-August (intense heat 30-35°C, coastal crowds). Mild but windy winters, some sites close.

title: Rome: Historic Center, Ancient Ruins & Vatican Treasures
subtitle: 4 days to traverse twenty centuries of history, from Piazza di Spagna to the Vatican domes, passing through ancient arenas, Trastevere's alleys, and Caravaggio's masterpieces.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for walking the historic center. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 30-35°C, massive tourist crowds). Mild winter (8-15°C) but rainy.

title: Northern Sardinia Coast: Beaches & Hidden Coves
subtitle: From Alghero's Catalan ramparts to Costa Paradiso's granite cliffs, then through La Maddalena's archipelago to the legendary Costa Smeralda — a complete six-day circuit of Sardinia's northern shores.
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 22-28°C, pleasant sea and fewer crowds. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 30-35°C, packed beaches, high prices). Mistral winds common in spring, sea still cool in April.

title: Complete Tour of Sicily
subtitle: From Palermo to the Greek temples of Agrigento, from the baroque towns of Ragusa to Mount Etna and Syracuse—the grand island tour in fourteen days.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-28°C, ideal for touring. Avoid July-August: scorching heat (35-40°C), sirocco winds, archaeological sites unbearable midday. Mild winter (12-16°C) but frequent rain on the north coast.

title: Casentino Circuit: Art, Villages and Sanctuaries
subtitle: From the lakeside villages of Umbria to the sacred forests of the Casentino, through the frescoes of Piero della Francesca and the medieval hilltop towns of the Valtiberina
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 15-26°C, ideal for exploring villages and sanctuaries. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 30-35°C in lowlands, heavy tourist crowds). The Casentino's altitude brings cooler air even in summer—pack a sweater for La Verna and Camaldoli.

title: From Lunigiana to Cinque Terre: Between Tuscany and Liguria
subtitle: A 4 days journey through prehistoric statue-menhirs, white marble quarries, the Gulf of Poets, and colourful villages clinging to the cliffs of Cinque Terre.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-25°C, pleasant sea from May. Avoid July-August (heat up to 32°C, massive crowds at Cinque Terre, trails packed). Mild winter (12-15°C) but frequent rain on the Ligurian coast.

title: Tuscany & Cinque Terre Road Trip: Renaissance Art, Chianti Hills & Coastal Villages
subtitle: From Pisa to the towers of San Gimignano, from Chianti vineyards to the suspended villages of the Cinque Terre—a journey through medieval Tuscany, the Etruscan coast, and the Ligurian Riviera.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C, ideal for Florence and Cinque Terre. Avoid July-August (scorching heat inland in Tuscany, up to 35°C, massive crowds). Mild coastal winters but frequent rain, possible fog in Chianti hills.

title: Aosta Valley Circuit: From Roman Gateway to Mont Blanc
subtitle: From Pont-Saint-Martin's ancient Roman bridge to Courmayeur at the foot of Mont Blanc, this 8 days journey ascends through the Aosta Valley, exploring medieval castles, Roman ruins, remote Walser valleys, and peaks soaring above 13,000 feet.
climate: Best period: June to September, temperatures 18-28°C in valleys, 10-15°C at altitude. Avoid November-April: heavy snow, mountain passes closed (especially to Cervinia and Courmayeur). Dry alpine climate, large temperature variations by elevation.

title: Vicenza Circuit: Palladian Villas and the Venetian Countryside
subtitle: From Palladio's city to the Asiago highlands: a 2 days circuit through Renaissance masterpieces, artisan traditions and the memory of the Great War
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C in the lowlands, cooler on the Asiago plateau. Avoid July-August (heavy heat up to 32°C, frequent storms) and December-February (dense fog in the plains, cold and snow in Asiago). Spring and autumn ideal for visiting Palladian villas.

title: Calabria - From Tropea to the Giants of Sila
subtitle: You descend the Tyrrhenian coast, climb back via Scilla and Reggio, then reach the forests of Sila before Cosenza.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-28°C on the coast, 15-25°C in Sila mountains. Avoid July-August (scorching heat on the coast, up to 38°C). Mild winter by the sea but frequent snow in Sila from December to March.

title: Authentic Molise in 3 Days: A Loop Through the Heart of Samnium
subtitle: A compact 350 km loop from Termoli to discover Italy's least-known region, its Roman and Samnite ruins, millennial craftsmanship, and peasant cuisine.
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 20-26°C, perfect for combining coast and highlands. Avoid July-August (stifling heat in Termoli, up to 35°C) and December-February (cold with possible snow in the Campobasso and Isernia hinterlands).

title: Marche & Abruzzo in 8 Days: From Rimini to Pescara, Hills to Wild Nature
subtitle: A 8 days journey descending through central Italy, from Urbino's Renaissance to the Gran Sasso Apennines, from Adriatic trabocchi to Abruzzo National Park—with its bears and wolves.
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C on the Adriatic coast, 15-22°C in the mountains. Avoid July-August (scorching heat up to 35°C, mass tourism) and December-March in the Apennines (snow, closed roads). The Abruzzo hinterland stays cool even in summer.

title: Sardinia's Wild Interior and Eastern Coast: 6 Days from Olbia to Cagliari
subtitle: A 6 days road trip that plunges into Barbagia, follows the Gulf of Orosei, and finishes in the little-known mining south.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-28°C, ideal for mountainous interior and coves. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 35°C+, crowded coasts) and November-March (frequent rain, tricky mountain roads). Mistral winds can blow hard on the east coast.

title: Sannio, Irpinia & Daunia: 5 Days Through Italy's Interior from Naples to Foggia
subtitle: A grand 5 days tour following the Apennine ridge between Campania and Puglia, from Samnite hilltop villages to Daunia's Romanesque cathedrals.
keywords: taurasi greco di tufo fiano avellino wine route
faeto celle di san vito francoprovençal
climate: Best time: April-May and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for visiting. Avoid July-August: scorching heat (35-40°C in the Foggia plain). Winter is cold at altitude (Irpinia, Sannio), mild but rainy in the lowlands.

title: Puglia: 3 days through the Murgia Barese, from Polignano's cliffs to the Tarantine ravines
subtitle: A 3 days loop descending from Bari to Taranto via whitewashed villages, limestone gorges and traditional pottery workshops.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-28°C, optimal sunshine. Avoid July-August: scorching heat (35-40°C), frequent sirocco winds, crowded sites. Mild winter (10-15°C) but possible rain in the ravines.

title: Piedmont - 3 days in Nebbiolo country, from Torino to Barolo
subtitle: A 3 days itinerary explores the UNESCO-listed Langhe and Monferrato, from Torino vermouth to Serralunga Barolo, via Alba white truffles and Canelli's underground cathedrals.
keywords: slow food bra pollenzo banca del vino
climate: Best time: September-October (harvest season, 15-22°C) and April-May (18-24°C), perfect for vineyard tours. Avoid July-August (stifling heat up to 35°C in the plains) and December-February (persistent fog, 0-5°C). Spectacular autumn colors across the wine country.

title: Puglia Wine Route - 7 Days
subtitle: An itinerary from Bari to Lecce crosses Alberobello's trulli, Lecce's baroque splendor, and vineyards of primitivo, negroamaro, and nero di Troia across 110,000 hectares of vines.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-28°C, ideal sunshine. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 32-38°C, occasional scirocco winds). Winter is mild (12-16°C) but windy, not ideal for vineyard visits.

title: Veneto in 8 days: Verona, Valpolicella, Soave, Prosecco, and Venice
subtitle: A route from Verona to Venice that crosses three opposing wine worlds—the powerful reds of Valpolicella, the garganega whites of Soave, the bubbles of the UNESCO Prosecco hills—before ending at a bacaro on the Grand Canal.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 16-25°C, ideal for vineyards and Venice. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 30-35°C, high humidity, crowds). Winter is cold (2-8°C) with frequent fog and risk of acqua alta in Venice from November to January.

title: The Essential Friuli-Venezia Giulia
subtitle: From Trieste's Imperial grandeur to the clockmaker villages of Carnia, a journey through Austro-Hungarian squares, Roman ruins, the Adriatic lagoon, and Alpine valleys
climate: Best period: May-June and September, temperatures 18-25°C. Avoid the Bora (icy northeast wind) in winter on Trieste and the coast. Summer is hot (25-30°C) but manageable, swimming possible in Grado.

title: Genoa to Sestri Levante via the Tigullio: 2 Days on the Riviera di Levante
subtitle: 2 days hugging the eastern Ligurian coast, from the cliffs of Nervi to the Bay of Silence, via Camogli, Portofino, and Rapallo.
climate: Best time: April-May and September-October, temperatures 18-24°C, pleasant sea from June. Avoid July-August (crowds, heat 28-32°C) and November-February (frequent rain, many establishments closed). Year-round mild microclimate thanks to the Alps blocking northern winds.

title: Deep Dive into Tigullio & Golfo Paradiso: 3 Days on the Eastern Riviera
subtitle: 3 days to explore every cove of Liguria's eastern coast, from Genoa's Nervi waterfront to the Bay of Silence, with hiking trails through Portofino's protected parkland.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-25°C, pleasant sea from May. Avoid July-August (massive crowds, heat 28-32°C, high prices). Mild winter (10-15°C) but frequent rain from November to February.

title: 6-Day Grand Tour of the Riviera di Levante
subtitle: 6 days from Genoa to Levanto exploring the entire eastern Ligurian coast and its hinterland
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 16-24°C, pleasant sea from May. Avoid July-August (heat, massive crowds in coastal villages, high prices). Mild winter (10-14°C) but rainy with cold sea.

title: Riviera di Ponente and Ligurian Hinterland in 3 Days
subtitle: This 3 days circuit alternates between the Ligurian coast and the perched villages of the interior, from Sanremo to Savona.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-26°C on the coast, cooler inland. Avoid July-August (heat, massive tourist crowds). Winter is mild by the sea but rainy, Sassello may see snow.

title: From Sanremo to Savona Along the Coast: 2 Days on the Ponente Riviera
subtitle: 2 days hugging the shoreline, from Sanremo's flower markets to Finale's dramatic cliffs, with stops at western Liguria's finest medieval villages.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-25°C, ideal for coastal touring. Avoid July-August (intense heat up to 32°C, tourist crowds, high prices). Mild winter (10-15°C) but occasional rainy spells.

title: Grand Tour of the Riviera di Ponente in 4 Days
subtitle: 4 days to explore every major village along the western Ligurian coast, from Ventimiglia to Savona, with a journey into the mountainous hinterland.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-24°C, pleasant sea. Avoid July-August (heat, crowds) and November-January (frequent rain, Sassello can be cold). The coast stays mild in winter but the hinterland gets noticeably cooler.

title: Dark Piedmont - 8 days from mystical Turin to Valle d'Aosta
subtitle: Eight days in Italy's esoteric capital at the apex of the white and black magic triangles, the cursed Lucedio abbey with its possessed monks, the Sacra di San Michele that inspired The Name of the Rose, the Holy Shroud and Roman forts of Valle d'Aosta.
climate: Best period: May-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C in the valleys, cooler at altitude. Avoid July-August (Turin can hit 35°C, frequent mountain storms) and December-February (alpine passes closed, extreme cold in Aosta Valley). Spring and fall offer ideal conditions for combining lowlands and mountains.

title: Haunted Sicily - 8 Days from the Capuchin Crypts to Stromboli
subtitle: Eight days through Europe's most charged island: 8,000 mummies beneath Palermo, Crowley's occult abbey in Cefalù, Stromboli erupting every twenty minutes, and Catania Cathedral guarding the veil that supposedly stopped Etna's lava.
climate: Best time: April-May and September-October, temperatures 20-26°C, calm seas for the Aeolian Islands. Avoid July-August (scorching heat up to 40°C, massive crowds). Mild winter but windy at sea, ferries sometimes cancelled.

title: Dark Tuscany - 7 Days from the Etruscans of Volterra to Occult Rome
subtitle: Seven days through a parallel Italy: alabaster funerary urns, 65-foot-high Etruscan sunken roads, Bomarzo's monster park, the dying city on its tuff pinnacle, and esoteric Rome from the Alchemical Door to the Capuchin cemetery.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 16-26°C, ideal for hilltop villages. Avoid July-August (scorching heat in Rome, 30-38°C, heavy crowds). Mild but rainy winters in inland Tuscany.

title: Marche & Umbria: 8 days Among Mummies, Mystics & Caves
subtitle: 8 days through the dark underbelly of central Italy, following saints who spoke to wolves, mummies that refused to decay, and rivers that carved hell beneath the Apennines.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for visiting Assisi and caves. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 30-35°C in cities, tourist crowds). Cold winters in the Apennines (Norcia), snow possible.

title: Naples to Matera Road Trip: 16 Days Through Southern Italy
subtitle: Sixteen days between Campania and Basilicata crossing Cilento, Vulture, and the Lucanian Dolomites, from Naples to Matera.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 18-26°C. Avoid July-August (scorching heat on the coast, 30-35°C) and winter in highland villages (risk of snow). Spring offers blooming Cilento, autumn provides ideal light for Matera.

title: Dark Apulia: 8 Days from Bari to Esoteric Naples
subtitle: Eight days through Apulia, Basilicata, and Campania to explore Frederick II's esoteric Castel del Monte, the Sassi of Matera, the ghost town of Craco, and Naples's cult of Purgatory souls.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, temperatures 20-26°C. Avoid July-August: scorching heat inland (Matera, Craco), often 35°C+. Mild but rainy winters along the coast.

title: Bassa Padana: Verdi, Guareschi and the Gonzaga in 8 Days
subtitle: From Piacenza to Mantua, a road trip through castles, culatello cellars and forgotten villages of the Po Plain.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for cultural tours. Avoid July-August (heatwaves with 30-35°C and oppressive humidity) and December-February (dense Po Valley fog, damp cold). The region is accessible year-round but very uncomfortable in midsummer and foggy winter.

title: Matilda's Lands: The Countess's Castles in 5 Days
subtitle: From Reggio Emilia to Scandiano, a road trip through medieval fortresses and Emilian hills.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for exploring hillside castles. Avoid July-August (oppressive heat 30-35°C, very humid) and December-February (dense fog in the plains, cold 2-8°C). Moderate rainfall in spring and autumn.

title: Bari, Castel del Monte, Matera: 14 Days Through the Murgia
subtitle: Over 14 days, you follow the Adriatic coast, cross the Murgia and the Vulture, then reach Matera and Polignano.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, 18 to 27°C, sea still swimmable in September. Avoid July-August: up to 35°C on the Murgia, zero shade at archaeological sites, and Polignano saturated by 9 AM. The Lucanian interior (Melfi, Acerenza, above 800 m) stays cool in the evening, even midsummer.

title: The Bari Loop: trulli, ravines and Matera in 13 days
subtitle: Loop through Puglia in 13 days from Bari: trulli, white hilltop towns, cave ravines, and the Sassi of Matera.
climate: Best period: April-June and September-October, 18-27°C, dry air. Avoid July-August, when inland Murge temperatures often exceed 35°C and the ravines become impassable in the afternoon. Winter stays mild on the coast but colder and windier at 400 meters, in the Valle d'Itria.

title: Puglia: Terra di Bari in 9 Days, Castel del Monte
subtitle: Trace the Adriatic coast, the Murgia and its Romanesque cathedrals in 9 days, from Bari to Castel del Monte.
climate: Best period: April–June and September–October, 18–26°C, sea still or already swimmable. Avoid July–August on the coast (heavy heat, crowded beaches, high prices). On the interior Murgia, winter is cool and windy, around 8–12°C.

title: Hokkaido's Summer Road Trip: Furano Lavender, Shikotsu-Tōya Parks & Coast
climate: Best time: late June to early September (64-79°F), Furano's lavender peaks mid-July. Avoid November-March: heavy snow, 23-41°F, challenging winter roads. Cool, dry summers—perfect escape from Japan's sweltering heat.

title: Extreme Hokkaido Road Trip: Arctic Nature and Volcanoes
subtitle: 20 days through the far north: from Pacific cliffs to caldera lakes, lavender fields to the arctic islands of Rishiri and Rebun, from Hakodate to Japan's northern edge at Wakkanai
climate: Best period: May-June and September-October, temperatures 15-23°C, clear roads. Avoid December-March: heavy snow, mountain passes closed (Shiretoko inaccessible). July-August ideal for Rishiri-Rebun islands but more crowded.

title: Kanto Flower & Landscape Journey
subtitle: From Hitachi Park's nemophila seas to Ashikaga's wisteria cascades, from Nikko's waterfalls to Nokogiri's cliff edges—15 days through flowering hills, turquoise lakes, and the wild coasts of Kanto
climate: Best time: April-May (cherry blossoms, 15-22°C) and October-November (fall foliage, 18-23°C). Avoid June-July (rainy season) and August (oppressive heat, 30-35°C, high humidity). Mountain areas (Nikko, Hakone) may have snow December-March.

title: Tohoku Lakes & Volcanoes Circuit
subtitle: From Fukushima to Aomori through crater lakes, historic hot springs, and the pristine forests of deep Tohoku
climate: Best period: late April-May and September-October, temperatures 12-22°C, ideal for lakes and hiking. Avoid December-March (heavy snow, mountain roads closed at Zao Okama and Hachimantai) and June (rainy season). Summer is hot and humid with typhoon risk.

title: Okinawa and Ryukyu Islands Journey: Beaches and Culture
subtitle: From Naha to Miyakojima: sacred temples, scarlet castles, coral reefs, and turquoise lagoons in 12 days
climate: Best time: March-May and October-November, temperatures 22-28°C, calm seas. Avoid July-September (frequent typhoons, high humidity) and June (monsoon season). Mild winter but cool water for swimming.

title: Kyushu & Yakushima Circuit: Volcanoes and Ancient Forests
subtitle: 13 days from Kitakyushu to Yakushima: feudal castles, mythological gorges, Beppu's smoking hells, Aso's volcanic crater, and Yakushima's UNESCO primeval forest
climate: Best time: April-May and October-November, temperatures 18-24°C. Avoid June-July (rainy season, monsoon), August-September (oppressive heat 30-33°C + typhoons). Yakushima is extremely rainy year-round, bring waterproof gear.

title: Tokai and Japanese Alps Circuit: Waterfalls and Villages
subtitle: 14 days among sacred waterfalls of Mount Fuji, suspension bridges over emerald lakes, UNESCO thatched villages and thousand-year-old shrines
keywords: japan road trip off beaten path
climate: Best time: April-May and October-November, temperatures 15-23°C, ideal for the Alps and coast. Avoid the rainy season (mid-June to mid-July) and summer (oppressive humid heat, possible typhoons). Winter in Shirakawa-go: heavy snow, bring appropriate gear.

title: San'In and Hiroshima Road Trip: Japan's Secret Coast
subtitle: From Tottori's dunes to Nagato's torii gates, along the Sea of Japan and its ancient shrines.
keywords: san in coast sea of japan
bitchu matsuyama castle sea of clouds
climate: Best period: April-May and October-November, temperatures 15-24°C, ideal for the San'In coast. Avoid January-February (heavy snow on the Sea of Japan side) and July-August (humid heat +30°C, tsuyu rainy season). Winter is harsh in this region.

title: Grand Tour of Cambodia: Mekong, Angkor, Battambang & Southern Coasts
subtitle: The complete 15 days circuit from the capital to the temples, passing through Mekong dolphins, Battambang countryside, and Kampot beaches
climate: Best time: November to February, temperatures 25-30°C, dry and sunny. Avoid March-April (extreme heat up to 40°C) and May-October (monsoon with daily rains, high humidity, roads sometimes impassable). Visit Angkor early morning during dry season.

title: South Korea Grand Tour: Seoul, Gyeongju & Busan
subtitle: Eleven days from Seoul to Busan via the ancient Silla capital, by high-speed rail: royal palaces, UNESCO sites, Buddhist temples, and world-class street food.
climate: Best time: April-May and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, clear skies. Avoid July-August (monsoon season, oppressive humid heat, up to 90% humidity). Seoul winters are harsh (-5 to 5°C).

title: Complete South Korea: Seoul, Busan & Jeju
subtitle: Fifteen days from Seoul to Jeju: the grand mainland tour followed by three days on a triple-UNESCO volcanic island.
climate: Best time: April-May (cherry blossoms, 15-22°C) and September-October (fall foliage, 18-24°C). Avoid July-August monsoon season (daily torrential rains, oppressive 80%+ humidity) and December-February winter (Seoul often drops to -10°C). Jeju stays milder but windy in winter.

title: Essential Seoul: Palaces, Neighborhoods & the DMZ
subtitle: 7 days exploring Seoul and its surroundings: the five palaces of the Joseon Dynasty, the alleys of Bukchon, the DMZ at the North Korean border, and the capital's lively neighborhoods.
climate: Best time: April-June and September-November, 15-25°C with clear skies. Avoid July-August (scorching heat 30-35°C + monsoon with heavy rainfall). Winter is freezing (−5 to 5°C) but dry, doable with proper gear.

title: Kazakhstan Road Trip: Almaty, Tian Shan Canyons and Alpine Lakes
subtitle: From the snow-capped peaks above Almaty to the Bronze Age petroglyphs of Tamgaly, via Charyn Canyon, the emerald Kolsai Lakes and Astana's futuristic architecture
climate: Best time: May-June and September, daytime temperatures 15-25°C with cool nights in the mountains. Avoid July-August (scorching heat in the steppes, up to 40°C) and December-March (severe frost -20 to -30°C, impassable roads). Wide temperature swings: bring layers.

title: Authentic Laos: 15-Day Itinerary Through Temples, Waterfalls and Mekong Islands
subtitle: A spiritual journey through golden monasteries, turquoise lagoons and villages frozen in time
climate: Best time: November to February, pleasant temperatures 20-28°C, dry and sunny. Avoid March-April (scorching heat up to 40°C) and May-September (monsoon season, heavy daily rains). Waterfalls are spectacular after monsoon but some roads may be challenging.

title: Far Northern Laos: Trekking through Tea Plantations and Tribal Villages
subtitle: An authentic journey through ancestral plantations, tribal villages and spectacular landscapes in the most remote lands of northern Laos
climate: Best time: November to February, cool temperatures 12-22°C at altitude, clear skies. Avoid May to October (heavy monsoon, muddy trails, leeches) and March-April (scorching heat before rains). Nights can be cold in Phongsali in December-January.

title: Adventure in Northern Laos: Jungles, Ethnic Villages and Spectacular Karsts
subtitle: An authentic immersion through primary forests, mountain villages and spectacular karst landscapes of northern Laos
climate: Best period: November to February, temperatures 15-25°C, cool nights in the mountains. Avoid the monsoon (June-September): torrential rains, muddy roads, and dangerous rivers. March-April: intense dry heat (up to 35°C) and haze from slash-and-burn.

title: Laos Central-East: Secret War History - 11-Day Circuit
subtitle: Uncover the untold story of the Secret War through caves, battlefields, and resilient communities.
climate: Best time: November to February, with daytime temperatures between 15-25°C and cool mountain nights. Avoid June to September (monsoon season makes mountain roads impassable) and March to May (scorching heat, 35-40°C). High-altitude plateaus can drop to 10°C in December-January.

title: Northern Laos: Mekong Slow Boat and Gibbons - 11-Day Circuit
subtitle: From tree houses perched 40 meters high to the legendary Mekong, an adventure through Northern Laos
climate: Best period: November to February, temperatures 15–25°C, clear skies over the Mekong. Avoid April–May (scorching heat up to 38°C) and July–September (monsoon season, torrential rains, muddy roads). March and October are acceptable but warmer.

title: Sri Lanka Off the Beaten Path
subtitle: From Colombo to hidden temples, from jungles to deserted beaches: Sri Lanka far from the crowds.
keywords: sri lanka off the beaten path
climate: Best period: February-April, temperatures 28-33°C, dry on both coasts. Avoid May-September on the west coast (southwest monsoon), October-January on the east coast (northeast monsoon). This multi-coast itinerary requires navigating regional monsoons.

title: The Baltics: From Vilnius to the Dunes and Riga in 14 Days
subtitle: From Vilnius's baroque old town to Riga's Art Nouveau facades, via the soaring dunes of the Curonian Spit.
climate: Best time: May to September, temperatures 15-23°C, long days (up to 18 hours of daylight in June). Avoid November to March: harsh cold (-5 to 2°C), short days, persistent grey skies. Baltic coast windy and cool even in summer (15-20°C), bring a jacket.

title: Latvia Road Trip: Medieval Castles, Baltic Coast and Soviet-Era History
climate: Best period: May to September, temperatures 15-22°C, long pleasant days for castles and coastal visits. Avoid November-March (0 to -5°C, frequent rain/snow, very short days). Baltic winds can be brisk along the coast even in summer.

title: Moldova in 10 days: from giant wine cellars to the ghost of the USSR
subtitle: 10 days to descend into the world's largest wine cellars and cross the last Soviet frontier.
climate: Aim for May-June or September-October: 18 to 25°C above ground, stable skies, harvest season in September. Avoid July-August, when the thermometer climbs toward 35°C and storms turn the dirt tracks to Rudi, Țipova, and Butuceni into muddy nightmares. December to February brings frost and black ice that make northern secondary roads genuinely nasty. Inside the cellars it stays 12 to 14°C year-round: pack a fleece even in high summer.

title: Montenegro Adventure: Bay of Kotor, Durmitor National Park and Ancient Towns
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, with 20-28°C on the coast and cool mountain temperatures. Avoid July-August (scorching heat up to 35°C, massive crowds) and winter (Durmitor and Tara Canyon roads closed by snow from November to April). Mountains stay cool even in summer.

title: Northern Madagascar Road Trip: Tsingy, Three Bays & Nosy Be
subtitle: From Diego Suarez to the Nosy Be archipelago: wild bays, stone forests, and turtle islands.
climate: Best time: April to November, temperatures 25-30°C, dry season ideal for Ankarana Tsingy and Nosy Be beaches. Avoid January-March: torrential rains, Ankarana roads become impassable, cyclone risk. July-August brings cool winds on the coast but perfect diving conditions.

title: Madagascar's Central Highlands: Culture, Crafts and RN7 Rainforests
subtitle: A loop from Antananarivo through royal hills, Zafimaniry workshops, Ranomafana lemurs and highland rice terraces - no flights, no rush.
climate: Best time: April to October (dry season), temperatures 15-25°C on the Highlands. Avoid December-February: torrential rains, muddy roads and cyclone risk. Bring warm clothes for cool evenings at altitude.

title: North Macedonia: 10-day lakes and monasteries loop
subtitle: This 10-day road trip connects Skopje to Ohrid through Byzantine monasteries, ancient lakes and wild mountains.
climate: Best period: May-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for lakes and mountains. Avoid July-August (scorching heat in Skopje and Bitola, 35-40°C) and winter in mountains (snow at Mavrovo and Pelister, difficult roads). Continental climate with dry summers and occasional storms.

title: Grand Mongolia Tour: Altai, Gobi, and Central Steppe
subtitle: 20 days from end to end - from the Kazakh Altai to the Gobi dunes, through volcanic lakes and Genghis Khan's ancient capital
climate: Best time: late May-June and September, daytime temperatures 15-25°C, cool nights. Avoid July-August (frequent storms, scorching Gobi at 40°C+) and April-May (strong winds, sandstorms). Extreme winter (-30°C) unsuitable for this route.

title: Mongolia Road Trip: Gobi Desert, Orkhon Valley & Lake Khövsgöl
subtitle: 19 days across desert, central steppe and the great northern lake — entirely by 4x4, no internal flights.
climate: Best time: June to September, daytime temperatures 15-25°C. Avoid November-March entirely (temperatures -20 to -40°C, roads impassable). The Gobi Desert experiences extreme day-night temperature swings; Lake Khövsgöl stays frozen until May.

title: Martinique Circuit: Mount Pelée and Beaches
subtitle: From Saint-Pierre's volcanic ruins to white-sand southern beaches, via Mount Pelée and historic Creole estates.
climate: Best time: December to April (dry season), temperatures 26-30°C, calm seas. Avoid August-October (high hurricane risk) and June-November (daily rain, heavy humidity). Mount Pelée often shrouded in morning clouds.

title: Mauritius in Depth: 15 Days from the Interior to the Coast
subtitle: Central plateau, Tea Route, endemic forests, wild south, and beach rewards – the complete journey to truly understand Mauritius.
climate: Best time: May to November, temperatures 20-26°C, dry and sunny. Avoid January-March (cyclone risk, heavy rainfall, humid heat up to 33°C). The central plateau (Curepipe) stays cooler year-round.

title: Family Mauritius - 15 days around the island, from the southeast to Le Morne
subtitle: Fifteen days of excursions from four coastal bases to swim with dolphins, spot whales, try buggies and explore the island with children.
climate: Best time: May to December, temperatures 20-28°C, calm seas and little rain. Avoid January to March (cyclones, humid heat up to 33°C, heavy downpours). East coast receives more rain than west year-round.

title: Wild Northern Mexico: Huasteca, Zacatecas & Copper Canyon
subtitle: 14 days of adventure from San Luis Potosí to Chihuahua: tropical jungle, ghost town, colonial cities, and the legendary train along canyon edges.
keywords: el chepe train barrancas del cobre
climate: Best time: October to April, dry season with 15-28°C depending on altitude (canyon, plateau, coast). Avoid June-September: torrential rains in the Huasteca and Copper Canyon, roads sometimes impassable. In winter, bring warm clothes for the canyon heights (freezing possible).

title: Mexico Road Trip: From the Mayan Caribbean to Mexico City
subtitle: The grand 21-day tour of Mexico, from Cancún to Mexico City. This is the classic route—the one we recommend for a first visit. Start with the beaches and cenotes of the Yucatán, step back in time at Chichén Itzá and Uxmal, plunge into the jungle at Palenque, climb to new altitudes in San Cristóbal, get lost in the markets of Oaxaca, and finish in the Aztec megacity. The Cancún → CDMX direction makes sense: save the cultural knockout of Mexico City for the end, when you're warmed up. One logistical note: the San Cristóbal → Oaxaca leg (Day 14) takes 10-11 hours by road—we recommend the domestic flight (1 hour) to keep your energy up.
climate: Best time: November to March, with 22-28°C on the coast and 15-25°C at altitude (Mexico City, San Cristóbal). Avoid May-June (scorching heat in Yucatan, up to 40°C) and September-October (heavy rains, hurricane risk on the coast). Pack warm layers for cool evenings at altitude in San Cristóbal (2100m) and Mexico City.

title: Mexico Road Trip: Oaxaca & Southern Pacific Coast
subtitle: From Zapotec markets and Monte Albán ruins to the wild Pacific beaches—a journey for those who want to truly know Oaxaca.
climate: Best period: November-April, temperatures 25-32°C on the Pacific coast, 15-25°C in Oaxaca and Mexico City. Avoid June-October: heavy daily rainfall, hurricane risk on the coast (Puerto Escondido, Huatulco), roads sometimes impassable. Mexico City and Oaxaca remain visitable year-round but expect afternoon downpours in summer.

title: Northeast Mexico: Monterrey, Desert & Mapimí, 12 Days
subtitle: From the Sierra Madre to the white dunes of Coahuila, a 12-day road trip through canyons, caves, and vineyards.
climate: Best period: March-May and October-November, temperatures 20-28°C. Avoid June-September (scorching heat 35-42°C in the desert, severe thunderstorms). Winter mild during the day but freezing nights in Mapimí desert (down to 0°C).

title: Borneo Explorer: 12 Days Through Sarawak & Sabah
subtitle: Kuching and its proboscis monkeys, Mulu's giant caves, the Kinabatangan River where pygmy elephants and orangutans cross paths—twelve days on the Malaysian side of Borneo.
climate: Best time: March-April and July-October, temperatures 26-32°C with moderate rainfall. Avoid November-February (northeast monsoon brings heavy rain to Sabah, difficult access to Mulu). Constant heat and humidity year-round (80-90%), pack light breathable clothing and rain gear.

title: Grand Malaysia Circuit: Peninsula & Borneo in 22 Days
subtitle: From KL's skyline to Cameron's misty tea terraces, George Town's murals to the Perhentians' reef sharks, then across the South China Sea to Borneo's proboscis monkeys, cave cathedrals, wild orangutans, and the last pygmy elephants on Earth.
climate: Best time: March-April and July-September, temperatures 25-32°C with less rain. Avoid November-February on the east coast (Perhentian): heavy monsoon, resorts closed. Equatorial humid climate year-round, frequent thunderstorms even in dry season.

title: Peninsular Malaysia Circuit: From KL to the Perhentian Islands
subtitle: Kuala Lumpur, the tea hills of Cameron Highlands, George Town's colonial lanes, and the Perhentian reefs—8 days between cities and beaches.
climate: Best period: March to October, temperatures 27-33°C in lowlands, 15-25°C in Cameron Highlands. Avoid November-February: northeast monsoon brings heavy rain, rough seas, and Perhentian Islands closures. Expect high humidity year-round with frequent afternoon thunderstorms.

title: Namibia-Botswana Safari: Sossusvlei, Etosha & Okavango Delta - 21 Days
subtitle: This itinerary was created by Mungo Park, a Geneva-based agency specializing in tailor-made African travel. If you'd like it customized to your needs, contact Mégane at +41 22 940 22 22 or via mungopark.ch/. Budget with agency assistance is around 450 euros per person per night. Please note our tool currently doesn't account for dirt tracks and may show detours that don't exist.
climate: Best time: May to October (dry season), daytime 20-28°C, cool nights (5-15°C). Avoid November-March: scorching heat (35-40°C), heavy rains, and increased malaria risk. Okavango floods peak June-August, perfect for wildlife viewing as animals gather at waterholes.

title: Namibia 4x4 & Camping Road Trip: Deserts and Safari - 16 Days
subtitle: From the dunes of Sossusvlei to the safaris of Etosha, a family adventure in the heart of the desert
climate: Best time: May to October (dry season), daytime temperatures 15-25°C, nights 0-10°C. Avoid December-March: extreme desert heat (40°C+), possible rains, sometimes impassable roads. Pack warm layers for nights, even in summer.

title: New Caledonia Journey: UNESCO Lagoon and Kanak Culture
subtitle: Ten days linking Nouméa to the edge of the world: UNESCO-listed lagoon, Hienghène's black limestone cliffs, Fort Teremba's colonial penal history, and traditional pirogue across Upi Bay on the Isle of Pines.
climate: Best period: May to October (dry season), temperatures 20-26°C, calm seas, ideal for lagoon visits. Avoid January-March: high cyclone risk, humid heat (28-32°C), heavy rainfall. November-December workable but requires weather monitoring.

title: The Grand Tour - New Zealand in Its Entirety
subtitle: 27 days to see it all: Far North, East Cape, Wellington, West Coast, Queenstown, Milford Sound, Kaikoura and Akaroa - nothing left behind.
climate: Best time: November to March, temperatures 18-26°C, ideal for both islands. Avoid June-August: mountain roads closed (Milford, Mt Cook), frequent snow in the South, cold and rainy in the North. The West Coast stays very wet year-round (pack rain gear even in summer).

title: The Great Auckland-Christchurch Traverse: 22 Days Across New Zealand
subtitle: 22 days crossing both islands end to end, from Waiheke vineyards to Milford fjords, via West Coast glaciers and the wild Catlins coastline.
climate: Best time: October to April (Southern Hemisphere summer), temperatures 15-25°C depending on region. Avoid June-August: winter season, snow on mountain roads (Mount Cook, Queenstown), cold and wet weather. Pack waterproofs for the west coast (Franz Josef, Punakaiki): heavy rainfall year-round.

title: New Zealand: The Essential Two-Week Journey
subtitle: From Auckland to Queenstown, the classic two-island circuit - volcanoes, fjords, wild coastlines and Māori culture in 16 days.
climate: Best time: October-November and March-April, temperatures 12-22°C, fewer crowds and reasonable prices. Avoid June-August (cold in the mountains, roads sometimes closed to Mount Cook and Queenstown, snow). Changeable weather year-round: pack layers and waterproofs.

title: Oman Road Trip: Wadis, Desert and Mountains
subtitle: From the capital to the eastern coast, the Wahiba Desert and the heights of Jebel Akhdar: ten days to discover authentic Oman.
climate: Best time: November-March, temperatures 22-28°C, ideal for desert and wadis. Absolutely avoid May-September (extreme heat 40-48°C, oppressive coastal humidity, desert dangerous). Cool nights at Jebel Akhdar in winter (5-10°C), bring warm clothes.

title: Off the Beaten Path Panama: Caribbean Coast, Azuero & Pacific Islands
subtitle: Atlantic canal passage, pirate fortresses of Portobelo, Azuero folklore, Santa Fé highlands and the Pearl Islands - authentic Panama beyond the tourist trail.
climate: Best time: January-April (dry season), temperatures 27-32°C, calm seas for island hopping. Avoid May-November: daily torrential rain, oppressive humidity, rough seas. Caribbean coast (Portobelo) stays humid even during dry season.

title: Essential Peru Journey: Lima to Machu Picchu
subtitle: From Lima to the Paracas cliffs, from Huacachina's dunes to Nazca's geoglyphs, from Arequipa's white streets to Cusco's Inca stones and Machu Picchu.
climate: Best time: May to September, dry season in the Andes with daytime temperatures of 18-22°C (cold nights at altitude). Avoid December-March: heavy rainfall in Cusco and Machu Picchu area, potential Inca Trail closures. The coast (Lima, Paracas) is accessible year-round but foggy June-September.

title: Northern Peru Road Trip: Ancient Civilizations and Andes
subtitle: From Lima to the Andes and the cloud forest: 16 days tracing the footsteps of northern Peru's pre-Inca civilizations.
climate: Best time: May to September, dry season in the Andes (15-20°C daytime in Huaraz, 20-25°C on the coast). Avoid December-March: torrential rains in Chachapoyas and Huaraz, mountain roads become impassable. Bring warm clothing for high-altitude stops (Huaraz, Cajamarca).

title: Complete Polynesia: Society & Tuamotu Islands in 20 Days
subtitle: From Papeete to the atolls of Rangiroa and Fakarava, a journey between volcanoes, lagoons and shark passes across two archipelagos
keywords: tahiti moorea bora bora rangiroa fakarava
climate: Best time: May to October, dry season with 24-28°C and low humidity, ideal for diving and island hopping. Avoid November-March: humid heat (30-32°C), heavy rainfall, and tropical cyclone risk. Water temperature stays 26-29°C year-round.

title: Tahiti, Moorea & Bora Bora Circuit: Lagoons and Mountains
subtitle: From Papeete to Raiatea, a journey through turquoise lagoons, eroded volcanoes and sacred marae at the heart of the Polynesian triangle
climate: Best period: May to October (dry season), 24-28°C, optimal sunshine for lagoons. Avoid November-April: humid heat (up to 32°C), heavy rainfall and cyclone risk. Humidity remains high year-round.

title: Visayas Circuit: Cebu, Bohol and Siquijor in 14 Days
subtitle: From Cebu's colonial streets to Bohol's chocolate hills and Siquijor's turquoise waterfalls, a journey through the central Visayas
climate: Best time: December to May (dry season), temperatures 26-32°C with constant humid heat. Avoid June to November: southwest monsoon brings heavy rains and typhoon risk. The Visayas are less exposed than northern Philippines but remain vulnerable in September-October.

title: Palawan Circuit: Coron to Puerto Princesa in 12 Days
subtitle: Hidden lagoons, wartime wrecks, limestone cliffs and underground rivers - the complete north-to-south traverse of Palawan
climate: Best period: November to April, dry season with 26-32°C and calm seas for boat transfers. Avoid June to October (monsoon, daily heavy rainfall, disrupted maritime connections). December-February offer the best balance between weather and crowds.

title: Ultimate Philippines Grand Tour: Rice Terraces, Lagoons & Visayas in 21 Days
subtitle: From Manila to Banaue's ancient rice terraces, Palawan's limestone lagoons, the Visayas reefs, and Siargao's surf breaks — three weeks across the archipelago
climate: Best time: December to April, dry season with 26-32°C and maximum sunshine. Avoid June to October: southwest monsoon brings daily torrential rains and typhoon risk (peak August-September). May gets very hot and humid, November remains uncertain with late typhoons.

title: Baltic Coast Family Road Trip: Adventures on Poland's Pomeranian Coast
climate: Best time: June-August, temperatures 18-23°C, ideal for beaches and family activities. Avoid November-March (cold, windy, rainy, many sites closed). May and September are possible but the sea remains cold (15°C) and weather unstable.

title: Secret Eastern Poland: Primeval Forests, Painted Villages and Orthodox Heritage
subtitle: 10 days from the depths of Podlachia to the Carpathian foothills, far from the beaten track
climate: Best time: May-June and September, temperatures 15-22°C, ideal for Białowieża Forest. Avoid July-August (heat and frequent storms) and December-February (severe frost, snowy roads). Bring waterproof gear year-round.

title: Kraków, Tatras & Memory: Southern Poland in 7 Days
subtitle: Royal city, salt mines, Auschwitz memorial and hiking at 1,987m in the Tatra Mountains
climate: Best time: May-June and September, temperatures 15-22°C, ideal for Krakow and hiking in the Tatras. Avoid December-February (harsh cold, -5 to -10°C, heavy snow in mountains). July-August: pleasant but crowded, frequent thunderstorms at altitude.

title: Culinary Poland: From Tatra Pierogi to Baltic Herring
subtitle: 10 days tracing regional flavors from the southern Carpathians to the Hanseatic quays of Gdańsk
climate: Best time: May to September, temperatures 18–26°C, perfect for outdoor markets and terraces. Avoid November–March: harsh cold (-5 to 5°C), Tatra roads often snowbound, short daylight. Summer is ideal but book ahead (high season in Krakow and Gdansk).

title: Greater Poland: Birthplace of the Polish State in 9 Days
subtitle: From Poznań to Kalisz via Gniezno, this 9-day circuit follows the Piast Trail to the Vistula.
climate: Best time: May-June and September, temperatures 15-23°C, ideal for castles and historical sites. Avoid December-February (frost, snow, short days) and July-August (sometimes oppressive heat, frequent thunderstorms). Spring and autumn offer stable weather for road trips.

title: Kotlina Kłodzka in 10 Days: A Loop Through Waters and Stone
subtitle: 10 days among Frederician fortresses, thousand-year spas, and the sandstone labyrinths of the Sudetes.
keywords: Srebrna Góra largest mountain fortress Europe
Góry Stołowe Szczeliniec Błędne Skały hiking
climate: Best period: May-September, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for hiking in the Sudetes. Avoid December-March (harsh winter, -5 to 5°C, heavy snow). Frequent summer thunderstorms, morning fog in valleys.

title: 8 Days in Lubusz - Fortresses, Lakes and the Oder Valley
subtitle: Medieval castles, Nazi bunkers and UNESCO parks along the Oder and Warta rivers in 8 days.
keywords: Stalag Luft III Great Escape Żagań
Łagów Knights of St John castle lakes
climate: Best time: May-September, temperatures 16-24°C, ideal for lakes and forest walks. Avoid November-March: cold and damp (0-5°C), grey skies, icy roads in winter. July-August: afternoon thunderstorms but pleasant overall.

title: From Zamość to Szydłów: Eastern Poland in 7 Days
subtitle: A road trip through the forests of Roztocze, Renaissance towns along the Vistula, and medieval ramparts of the Świętokrzyskie highlands.
climate: Best period: May-September, temperatures 15-25°C, ideal for hiking and sightseeing. Avoid December-February (harsh cold, -5 to 0°C, frequent snow). Pleasant spring and fall but cool evenings.

title: West Pomerania: Szczecin, Baltic Sea & Lakes
subtitle: An 8-day road trip through Gothic brickwork, Baltic cliffs, secret forests and the glacial lakes of Pomerania.
climate: Best period: May-September, temperatures 15-22°C on the Baltic coast, ideal for beaches and lakes. Avoid November-March: harsh cold, rough seas, many sites closed. July-August: high season but changeable weather, bring a windbreaker.

title: Poland: From Wrocław to the Holy Cross Mountains in 6 Days
subtitle: Link Wrocław and its dwarves to Częstochowa, the Eagles' Nests castles, and the Holy Cross Mountains.
climate: Best time: May-June and September, temperatures 15-23°C, low rainfall. Avoid July-August (frequent storms, heat up to 30°C) and December-February (frost, snow, short days). Spring ideal for Jura castles and Świętokrzyskie forests.

title: Alentejo UNESCO Heritage: Évora, Elvas and Medieval Villages
climate: Best period: March-May and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C ideal for heritage sites and medieval villages. Avoid June-August: extreme heat regularly exceeding 38°C, little shade. Mild winter (10-15°C) but rainy, some sites less accessible.

title: Beira Interior Road Trip, Portugal: Serra da Estrela, Schist Villages & History
climate: Best time: May-June and September-October, temperatures 15-25°C at altitude, 20-28°C in valleys. Avoid December-March (snow at elevation, road closures to Sabugueiro, severe cold). Summer hot in lowlands (35°C+), but pleasant in the mountains.

title: Portugal Discovery Tour: From Lisbon to Alentejo Plains
